name: inventory_remove_count_bug
task: inventory_remove() shifts the array elements correctly to fill the gap left by the removed item, but never decrements inv->count. As a result the removed item's slot still exists logically: count stays the same, the last valid item appears duplicated at the end, and total_value/total_quantity report inflated totals. Fix inventory_remove() so count is decremented after a successful removal. Do not change the function's signature.
